question: How much does studying and living in China cost?
answer: Costs depend on the level, city and language of instruction. Rough guides: a language year — ¥7,000–14,000 per semester; a bachelor's — ¥16,000–30,000 per year; a master's — ¥20,000–40,000 per year; an MBA — from ¥60,000 per program. Living in Beijing and Shanghai costs more than in Hangzhou, Nanjing or Chengdu: budget ¥1,500–3,500 per month excluding flights. We put exact figures into the shortlist for each university and never hide additional fees.
